route_cypher: MATCH (n0:Entity {id: $start})-[r1:RELATES {etype: $t1}]->(n1:Entity)-[r2:RELATES {etype: $t2}]->(n2:Entity)-[r3:RELATES {etype: $t3}]->(n3:Entity) WHERE r1.is_current = true AND NOT r1.ns <> $ns AND r2.is_current = true AND NOT r2.ns <> $ns AND r3.is_current = true AND NOT r3.ns <> $ns RETURN r3.tb AS answer, r1.sid AS s1, r1.revision AS v1, r2.sid AS s2, r2.revision AS v2, r3.sid AS s3, r3.revision AS v3
